name: Hard: termination proof and complexity bound
description: A request to prove termination and derive a running-time bound resembles the hard candidates, not the easy ones
query: Prove this recursive algorithm always terminates and derive a tight bound on its worst-case time complexity.

name: Hard: weigh conflicting arguments under uncertainty
description: A request to weigh opposing forecasts and defend one resembles the hard candidates in a different domain
query: Two economists give opposite forecasts about inflation. Weigh their competing arguments and defend which forecast is more credible given the uncertainty.

name: Easy: retrieve a stated fact
description: Reading a value stated in the supplied text resembles the easy candidates, not the hard ones
query: In the email below, what time does the delivery arrive? 'Your package will arrive at 4pm on Friday.'

name: Easy: reformat supplied items
description: Copying supplied items into another format resembles the easy candidates in a different task shape
query: Rewrite this list as one comma-separated line: red, green, blue.
